description: Re-run your agent's webhook challenge-echo verification — the MCP twin of POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/webhook/verify, for endpoints that were down when the registration handshake fired. Fires the same GET <url>?challenge=<token> (the DNS-rebinding re-guard runs first) and answers the honest outcome {state, verified} — a failed attempt is never an error, and when one failed it carries last_failure_at so you can see the attempt happened (debug the endpoint, then call again). Optional agent_id selects among YOUR agents. Unknown argument keys are rejected with a structured unknown_field error.

inputSchema.description:
Re-run the webhook challenge-echo verification (``webhook_verify``).

The MCP twin of REST ``POST /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/webhook/verify``:
fires the same challenge GET the registration queued (endpoints that
were down at registration time), and answers the honest outcome
``{state, verified}`` — never an error for a failed attempt. A failed
attempt stamps ``last_failure_at``, surfaced here so
an agent debugging its doorbell can SEE the attempt happened. Strict
fields: unknown argument keys 422 as ``unknown_field``.

agent_id.description: Optional: which of YOUR agents the webhook belongs to. Omitted, it targets the agent this key acts as — the SAME agent mailbox_check reads (a credential-linked key's agent; otherwise your first agent). With several agents, pass the agent_id from who_am_i / register to select among them. An agent you do not own is refused (forbidden).
agent_id.title: Agent Id
